claims.quote: TBC1D24 gene variants have been associated with a phenotypic spectrum having epilepsy as the main clinical manifestation.
TBC1D24 gene variants are associated with various clinical features, and increasing data confirms the association with permanent and paroxysmal movement disorders.
Noteworthy, the patient fulfills all the diagnostic criteria for AHC. An epilepsy gene panel revealed a novel TBC1D24 mutation.
